```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
if (!require("EGAnet")) {install.packages("EGAnet"); require("EGAnet")} 
if (!require("psychTools")) {install.packages("psychTools"); require("psychTools")} 
```

```{r data}
# created in 01_data
# remove dataset identifier and clinical demos
merged_rm_ega_vars <- merged_rm_cleaned_items %>%
  select(-dataset_id, -starts_with("clinical_demo"))
```

# initial EGA wirg with item removal per UVA
```{r ega uva}
# unique variable analysis to see redunancies
rm_uva <- UVA(data = merged_rm_ega_vars)
rm_uva

rm_uva$keep_remove

# EGA
rm_uva_ega <- EGA(data = rm_uva$reduced_data, 
                  corr = "auto", 
                  model = "glasso", 
                  algorithm = "walktrap",
                  uni.method = "louvain",
                  plot.EGA = TRUE,
                  verbose = TRUE)

summary(rm_uva_ega)
plot(rm_uva_ega, layout = "circle")

# network loadings
net.loads(rm_uva_ega)

# boostrap for stability
rm_uva_boot <- bootEGA(
  data = rm_uva$reduced_data,
  corr = "auto", 
  model = "glasso", 
  algorithm = "walktrap",
  uni.method = "louvain",
  iter = 1000,
  seed = 123456 
)

# compare median structure between empirical and boot
rm_uva_compare <- compare.EGA.plots(
  rm_uva_ega, rm_uva_boot,
  labels = c("Empirical", "Bootstrap")
)

# summary stas about bootstrapped version
summary(rm_uva_boot)

# item stability
rm_uva_boot_dim <- dimensionStability(rm_uva_boot)

# "Item stability indicates how often an item replicates in their designated EGA dimension, with values lower than .75 (i.e., that are estimated in their original dimensions in 75% of the bootstrapped samples)"

# where are the items going in the times that it isn't going in its dimension
rm_uva_boot_dim$item.stability$item.stability$all.dimensions

# To improve fit/stability it's suggested to remove items with stability <75% and/or with network loadings lower than .15.

# save figures
pdf("02_output/rm_uva_ega_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
plot(rm_uva_ega) 
dev.off() 

pdf("02_output/rm_uva_ega_plot_circle.pdf", width = 13, height = 10)
plot(rm_uva_ega, layout = "circle") 
dev.off()

pdf("02_output/rm_uva_ega_comparison_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
rm_uva_compare <- compare.EGA.plots(rm_uva_ega, rm_uva_boot,
  labels = c("Empirical", "Bootstrap"))
dev.off()

pdf("02_output/rm_uva_ega_stability.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
dimensionStability(rm_uva_boot)
dev.off()
```

# remove lowest items after UGA
```{r EGA w item removals}
merged_rm_27_ega_vars <- merged_rm_cleaned_items %>%
  select(-rm_1, -rm_17, -rm_22, -rm_34, -rm_45, -rm_70, # per UVA
         -rm_20, -rm_21, -rm_23, -rm_33, -rm_49, -rm_27, -rm_9, -rm_11, -rm_37, # poor function
         -starts_with("clinical_demo"), -dataset_id)

# EGA

              corr = "auto", 
              model = "glasso", 
              algorithm = "walktrap",
              uni.method = "louvain",
              plot.EGA = TRUE,
              verbose = TRUE)

  data = merged_rm_27_ega_vars,
  corr = "auto", 
  model = "glasso", 
  algorithm = "walktrap",
  uni.method = "louvain",
  iter = 1000,
  seed = 123456 
)

# compare median structure between empirical and boot

  rm_27_ega, rm_27_boot,

)

rm_27_boot_dim$item.stability$item.stability$all.dimension

pdf("02_output/rm_items_removed_ega_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)

dimensionStability(rm_27_boot)
dev.off()
```

# removing UG screener, do UVA + EGA
```{r wo ug}
merged_rm_cleaned_items_x_UG <- merged_rm_cleaned_items %>%
  filter(dataset_id != 'UG_dat')

merged_rm_x_UG_ega_vars <- merged_rm_cleaned_items_x_UG %>%
  select(-dataset_id, -starts_with("clinical_demo"))

# unique variable analysis to see redunancies
rm_x_UG_uva <- UVA(data = merged_rm_x_UG_ega_vars)
rm_x_UG_uva

rm_x_UG_uva$keep_remove

# EGA
```
